test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

CIST_RNCI_TERNC_STER_
solution:
Given: CIST_RNCI_TERNC_STER_

 
• IENS → CIST**I**RN-CI**E**TERN-C**N**STER**S**
 
• IESN → CIST**I**RN-CI**E**TERN-C**S**STER**N**
 
• ESIN → CIST**E**RN-CI**S**TERN-C**I**STER**N**
 
• SENI → CIST**S**RN-CI**E**TERN-C**N**STER**I**

 
• Option (3) followed the cycle of "CISTERN".

Hence, the correct answer is "ESIN".
